entry.title: Undercrown 10 Corona Viva — Single
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, dark chocolate, cola or dark rum (projected)
Occasion: Proper UC10 blend test, after a meal, evening smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Black pepper, Mexican hot chocolate, earth, espresso, dried cherry and raisin sweetness make the Corona Viva one of the most attractive ways to sample Undercrown 10. At 5″ × 43 it is narrow enough to emphasize the dark San Andrés wrapper and peppery profile without becoming a tiny smoke, while the long-filler construction provides a proper reference for the blend before committing to a larger format or a tin of Coronets. Untasted here, so Strength 8 and Quality 8 remain projections and Flavour stays unrated.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. Cigar Hut currently lists the exact 5″ × 43 Undercrown 10 Corona Viva with a Single option at A$39 and purchasable package options. Flavour remains unrated until personally tasted.
